data.description: 虚幻引擎是一款由 Epic Games 开发的游戏引擎。该引擎主要是为了开发第一人称射击游戏而设计，但现在已经被成功地应用于开发潜行类游戏、格斗游戏、角色扮演游戏等多种不同类型的游戏。
data.label: Unreal Engine

data.description: Unreal Engine is a game engine developed by Epic Games. It was primarily designed for developing first-person shooter games but has since been successfully applied to developing stealth games, fighting games, role-playing games, and various other types of games.
